instructions: Trigger/discovery evals for the seven shipped skills, following the Agent Skills ecosystem loop: run each query against a fresh session whose harness lists only the skills' name+description (no SKILL.md body), repeat each 3 times, and record whether the intended skill is selected. Positive cases must trigger their expected skill; negative cases are near-misses that share trigger keywords but must NOT select any shipped skill (record 'none'). Development trials only: no repository writes, no live tracker. Treat a trigger rate below 0.5 on validation cases as a description defect to fix in SKILL.md frontmatter, then regenerate adapters.
